scope: Selected final production-E eight-cell point: independent microscopic hydrogen/lower-continuum attribution, conditional wind ODE comparison and fixed-atmosphere observer quadrature controls. These are partial diagnostics, not full reference, reduction or numerical-resolution qualification.

hydrogen.scope: Same-state microscopic hydrogen and non-IR lower-continuum attribution at the selected final E8 point. This aggregate establishes local diagnostic consistency and conditional effects; it does not establish reference agreement or reduction adequacy.

native_ledger.gross_flow_warning: Shell inflow excludes within-shell transitions but includes inter-shell radiative recycling. It is not an escaping Halpha photon fraction.

C23_microscopic.scope: Original C23 bare collisional/CI/LTE/RR helpers at final T/ne/H/He densities. Initialization illumination is never final-state radiation; no whole column or C23 SE/thermal root is inferred.

coefficient_comparisons.conventions: n/l/g and index order match. Source energies and inverse finite-mass conventions differ; energy differences are included in the measured coefficient comparison. Native spontaneous RR uses the exact existing continuum grid; C23 uses its cached/formula coefficients. This is not independent BF quadrature adequacy.

interpretation: At the frozen final state, replacing C23 collision/CI/inverse blocks has a small conditional n3/n2 effect. This does not bound amplification through radiation, temperature, electron density or wind.

With increasing radius the retained model loses collisional excitation and Halpha trapping. A rate decomposition identifies this behavior, not whether the chosen density/wind or transfer closure matches the paper.
The lower non-IR continuum materially affects inner-upper H bound-free balance. A dark lower boundary cannot be silently labeled identical in a C23 comparison.
limits: Only the six upper SE cells contribute to impact maxima. Auxiliary lower-cell solves are diagnostic raw outputs; their actual LTE prescription is unchanged.

Conditional matrices freeze T, electron and collider reservoirs, line operators/escape/depth, CT/molecules and other photon packets. No global response, changed thermal root or observer prediction is claimed.

The lower-field subtraction removes only its non-IR H photoionization and induced capture. Ordinary one-way line pumping, OTS, selected line groups, spherical IR and all spontaneous RR remain unchanged.
No inconsistent RR-only SE replacement with unchanged photo cross sections was performed.
Local reference and reduction requirements remain unknown; numerical radial refinement and a matched boundary/closure reference remain necessary.
preserved_execution_failures: Initial comparison attempted mutation of a read-only NumPy view; corrected to an explicit copy before any result.
Later report assembly took max over an empty same-n electron domain; corrected to null plus explicit counts, with all scientific inputs/gates unchanged.
Independent net-flow replay initially exposed floating-point reassociation against a small absolute diagnostic; original failure and same-association corrected replay are retained by its receipt.

wind.comparison: Independent DOP853 with matched constants and the exact final prescribed T/mu plus pressure-only outer knot.
wind.limits: Fixed profile only. The larger velocity-gradient difference and thermal forcing are reported separately; ODE agreement does not bound a coupled thermal/wind response or validate the endpoint prescription.

observer.limits: Same fixed E atmosphere and unchanged observation proxy. No radial, atomic, radiation-field or exact data-reduction adequacy claim.

assessment_effect: Append these measured controls to three existing unknown selected-E8 requirements without changing their status. Complete-root support and all other historical Assessment/Decision bases are preserved.
remaining: A matched, converged and independently refined reference with actual lower illumination and compatible closures.
Coupled radial/atomic/radiation refinement and sensitivity convergence; targeted ten-cell operator/root work remains separate.
